kurzbeschreibung: The Glungezerbahn in Tulfes opens up Mount Glungezer and the Kugelwald, the world's largest outdoor wooden ball track.
beschreibung:
Panoramic Cable Car and Alpine Mountain Joys

The Glungezerbahn whisks visitors from Tulfes comfortably up to the sunny scenic mountain in the Inntal. From the Tulfein mountain station, a sweeping panoramic vista opens up over the Inntal, the opposing Karwendelgebirge, and the Tuxer Voralpen.

Playful Magic in the Kugelwald

At the Halsmarter intermediate station, the Kugelwald am Glungezer thrills families with an attraction unmatched anywhere in the world: along giant wooden ball runs made of Swiss stone pine, hand-turned wooden balls zoom across spectacular tracks, jumps, and lifts straight through the alpine forest.
